aftercare.instruction: 30 mins after treatment, use provided cotton pad and wipe gently in circular motions. Pat dry and apply a very THIN layer of aftercare cream. Repeat EVERY HOUR until bedtime. Before sleeping, final wipe & cream application (use plastic wrap if normal/dry skin).
Every morning and night, wipe treated area with a damp cotton pad. Pat dry and apply a very THIN layer of cream. Repeat whenever skin feels tight or dry.
Days 1-5: Brows darken and scabs form. Days 5-9: Flaking starts (do not pick scabs). Days 9-12: Pigment looks milky due to fresh healing tissue. Days 12-21: True rich pigment blooms back.
Avoid sunbathing, solariums, chemical peels, Retinol A, AHA/BHA acids, laser procedures over area, and unnecessary antibiotics. Always apply SPF 30+ once healed.
